title: Adding Custom GBIF Datasets
description: Guide on how to export, configure, and ingest custom DarwinCore occurrence datasets directly from GBIF.org.

steps.title: Navigate to GBIF Occurrences Search
steps.description: Open GBIF.org in your browser and go to Occurrences. The website screenshots in this guide are examples; its layout may change.

steps.title: Filter Target Area and Taxa
steps.description: Filter for the geographic region, season, and taxonomic groups you want to learn. Choose observations with photographs for visual identification practice.

steps.title: Select DarwinCore Archive Download
steps.description: Select the 'Download' tab, choose 'Darwin Core Archive', and click 'Configure' to open the archive export options.

steps.title: Locate Multimedia Extension
steps.description: In the archive configuration panel, scroll down through the 'Extensions' list to find 'Multimedia', as shown in the next step.

steps.title: Enable Multimedia Extension
steps.description: Select the 'Multimedia' extension checkbox, then click 'Continue to Terms'. Import the complete ZIP so the multimedia information stays with the observations.

steps.title: Acknowledge Terms & Create Download
steps.description: Review the download terms and licenses associated with the datasets and photographs, check the agreement box, and click 'Create Download'. GBIF will prepare the archive.

steps.title: Copy Archive Download Link
steps.description: Once the export is ready, right-click the 'Download archive' button and select 'Copy link address' to copy the direct ZIP download URL to your clipboard.

steps.title: Clear Current Data Source (Optional)
steps.description: Open 'Settings & Data'. Imports add or update records. Only use 'Clear Current Data Source' if you want to remove current observations before importing a replacement. User progress and saved language, theme, sampling mode, and minimum threshold remain. A later failed import cannot undo this separate clearing action.

steps.title: Import Archive & Enrich Names
steps.description: Paste the ZIP URL or local path into 'Path or URL to DarwinCore dataset (.zip / occurrence.txt)' and click 'Start Ingestion' or 'Re-Ingest Dataset'. 'Max Occurrences Per Taxon' caps retained observations during import; 0 means unlimited. After completion, choose your display language and use 'Look Up Names' under 'Species Names' if desired.
